title: DataQualityRule
description: Schema for a data quality rule definition. Captures the dimension, expression, scope, threshold, severity, lifecycle state, ownership, and evidence for a single DQ rule across its full lifecycle from candidate through to monitored in production.

rule_id.description: Unique identifier for this data quality rule.

dimension.description: Data quality dimension this rule addresses.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this rule checks.

scope.description: Scope defining which entity, field, and optional filter condition this rule applies to.

entity.description: Table or entity name this rule applies to.

field.description: Field or column name this rule applies to. Use '*' for row-level or table-level rules.

condition.description: Optional filter condition (SQL WHERE clause fragment) to restrict the scope of the rule.

expression.description: The rule expression or logic, typically as a SQL predicate or function call.

threshold.description: Acceptable threshold for the rule (e.g. '100%', '>=99.5%', '0 failures').

lifecycle_state.description: Current lifecycle state of this rule.

owner.description: Team or individual responsible for this rule.

approver.description: Team or individual required to approve this rule before implementation.

source_ref.description: Reference to the source entity or system where the rule originates.

target_ref.description: Reference to the target entity or system where the rule is applied.

schedule.description: Schedule on which this rule is executed (e.g. 'daily at 06:00', 'on ingest', 'continuous').

failure_handling.description: Action to take when the rule fails (e.g. quarantine, alert, block load, log only).

evidence.description: References to evidence that supports or validates this rule.

lineage_ref.description: Reference to a lineage record linking this rule to its governing policy or requirement.
